acceptance_criteria.condition: The runner can seed the temporary directory that execute_condition has already created, then complete its public and hidden checks without a FileExistsError.
The retained v6 raw artifacts, interruption report, and result bundle agree that two pre-Agent conditions were interrupted and are ineligible for any partial effect statistic.
The frozen v6 preregistration retains its original runner digest while the corrected live runner remains covered by its own regression test for a future v7 protocol.

invariants: The interrupted v6 collection remains ineligible and cannot be retried, partially analyzed, or presented as a model or Skill outcome.

safeguards.name: historical protocol freeze
safeguards.rationale: The original v6 envelope and result are preserved as immutable interrupted evidence; only the live runner implementation is corrected.

safeguards.name: pre-created-directory regression
safeguards.rationale: The test exercises execute_condition end to end through public and hidden scoring with the same pre-created temporary-directory shape that exposed the defect.

safeguards.name: raw-archive consistency check
safeguards.rationale: The archive test recomputes the raw tree digest and checks both recorded conditions, FileExistsError logs, and ineligible result semantics.

design_boundary.rationale: copy_tree owns materializing a workspace into a caller-provided directory; execute_condition owns temporary-directory lifetime and the archive owns historical v6 classification.

dependency_audit.rationale: The repair uses existing Python standard-library shutil and unittest facilities; no dependency or lockfile changes.

extension_decision.rationale: No public extension point is introduced; the correction is local to the existing runner boundary.

data_ownership.rationale: The raw v6 tree and result are authoritative immutable collection evidence, while temporary execution workspaces are disposable and owned by execute_condition.

error_model.rationale: A pre-Agent FileExistsError is distinguished from Agent, public-test, hidden-test, scope, and timeout outcomes and remains an interrupted collection state.

contract_evolution.rationale: The v6 protocol is not rebound to repaired source; a new v7 envelope must carry the corrected runner digest and fresh corpus.

operational_budget.rationale: The existing agent and test timeouts remain unchanged; the regression completes public and hidden local checks within the declared five-second test budget.

threat_boundary.rationale: The regression retains post-exit hidden scoring and does not place hidden test content in the Agent prompt or mutable workspace input.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The runner repair, raw archive, regression tests, README clarification, and evidence ledger form one verified, reviewable Git change.

release_recovery.rationale: This offline evaluation package has no user-facing rollout or production recovery action.

data_migration.rationale: No application schema, persisted user data, or backfill behavior changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No runtime configuration, credential, or secret is added, changed, or archived.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency, registry source, license surface, or lockfile changes.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README, interruption report, archived raw stderr, regression transcript, tests, and this ledger record diagnosis, recovery boundary, and the required v7 next step.

reproducibility.rationale: Committed raw artifacts, SHA-256 digests, a deterministic fixture, and exact unittest commands reproduce both the interruption classification and corrected seeding behavior.

supporting_artifacts.summary: v6 archival report that records no Agent launch, two interrupted conditions, raw-tree digest, and ineligibility.
Frozen v6 runner result containing the preregistered protocol digest and two incomplete trial records.
Live post-interruption runner repair that copies task-tree contents into an empty existing destination and rejects stale files.
Runner test source containing the pre-created-directory success regression and non-empty-destination isolation guard.
Archive consistency test source for raw-tree digest, two FileExistsError artifacts, and ineligible result classification.

remaining_risks: The corrected runner has not and must not be used to resume v6; any formal collection requires a new v7 preregistration, Skill revision, and held-out corpus.
The repair proves the local temporary-directory owner caused this interruption, not that the Skill improves repair success or that a model has general causal capability.
Native Codex workspace isolation remains protocol isolation rather than a container-security boundary.

causal.symptom: The first v6 pair stopped before either Agent launched because its temporary workspace could not be seeded, leaving the preregistered collection incomplete and ineligible.

evidence_artifacts.summary: Captured pre-Agent v6 stderr containing the FileExistsError from the skill condition.
Historical classification that both conditions had agent_launched=false and the collection is ineligible.
Executed counterfactual regression with the repaired copy_tree behavior.
The repaired owner that materializes each source child into an empty caller-provided destination and rejects stale contents.

hypotheses.claim: copy_tree assumed that its destination did not exist even though execute_condition creates a TemporaryDirectory before seeding it.
hypotheses.prediction: A condition that reaches copy_tree with a pre-existing empty directory raises FileExistsError before run_agent; copying source children into that directory allows the condition to complete.

hypotheses.claim: A model-service or task-fixture failure prevented the v6 Agent calls.
hypotheses.prediction: The archived condition logs would show an Agent launch or service/task error after seeding rather than a local directory-copy failure.

causal.discriminating_check: Run execute_condition on a fixture with the TemporaryDirectory shape it creates in production, mock only the Agent process, and require successful seed, public, hidden, and scope results; compare that outcome with the archived pre-Agent stderr.
causal.upstream_path: execute_condition creates TemporaryDirectory -> seed_workspace calls copy_tree -> copy_tree invokes copytree on the existing run root -> FileExistsError -> run_agent is never reached -> interrupted result
causal.timeline_evidence: The raw v6 artifact records two FileExistsError diagnostics and agent_launched=false before any candidate write. The post-interruption smoke regression then exercised the same pre-created-directory shape with the corrected owner and completed successfully.

counterfactual.intervention: Materialize each source child into the already-created destination instead of invoking shutil.copytree with that destination as a required-nonexistent root, then run execute_condition against the same empty temporary-directory topology.
counterfactual.expected_outcome: The condition seeds its Git workspace, calls the mocked successful Agent, and passes public, hidden, and edit-scope checks without FileExistsError.
counterfactual.observed_outcome: The targeted regression completed with exit status 0; its result recorded trial_complete=true, hidden_repair_pass=true, and scope_ok=true.
controlled_factors: Same public and hidden unittest command shape
